{
  "screen_decision": "exclude",
  "screen_rationale": "The study describes a new pipeline for analyzing heart histopathology in mice and humans. It does not report any quantitative measure of agreement between animal model results and human clinical outcomes, such as concordance rates or translation success rates. Therefore, it does not meet the inclusion criteria for the systematic review.",
  "arm": "methods-and-bias",
  "arm_evidence": "The study focuses on developing and validating a 'semiautomated pipeline for quantitative analysis of heart histopathology', which pertains to the methodology of preclinical research.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "cardiovascular"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The study explicitly discusses 'Diseases affecting the heart' and analyzes 'cardiac histology' in both animal models and human samples related to cardiac conditions.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study analyzes both 'Mice' (animal model) and 'Human samples' (clinical data) within the same pipeline development.",
  "species": [
    "mouse"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study details experiments performed on 'Mice' and refers to them throughout the methodology and results sections.",
  "endpoint_class": "secondary-biomarker",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study quantifies parameters like 'cardiomyocyte area', 'minimum Feret Diameter (MinFeret)', 'nuclei area', 'capillary contacts', and 'pro-ANP expression', which are histological and molecular biomarkers, not primary hard clinical outcomes."
}
